name: Camp Belladona
source:
For your Senior Capstone project, you find yourself at the abandoned Camp Belladonna. Which is believed to be haunted by the spirit of Miss Belladonna herself.

Before 1902 summer camps were mainly male-dominated fields. Some believe that Miss Belladonna was ahead of her time, trying to push a female run camp in the early 1890’s which is what lead to her death by men not ready for progress.  Others saw it as foul play regarding betrayal of someone she knew.

Now you find yourself here at Camp Belladona, stuck between two possible love interests pinning for your time. And if you aren't careful, you may meet the same fate as her. 

[From [url=https://lostworldofshe.itch.io/camp-belladona]itch.io[/url]]
